payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into how lexicons are compared through evaluations by both crowds and experts, highlighting the differences in their approaches and the quality of annotations.

claims.text: Crowd evaluations of lexicons are compared to those of expert linguists to assess lexicon quality.
The crowd is capable of evaluating lexicons effectively, often producing quality results without the need for gold standards.
Expert evaluations tend to be stricter on linguistic elements, while crowd evaluations are stricter on emotional aspects.
The diversity of crowd contributors can enhance the evaluation process compared to uniform expert judgments.
